download_keypoints_for_capture_id: download and decompress ReInterHand keypoints_orig data for a given capture ID from the S3 bucket
run_download_all_keypoints: run the script to download and extract keypoints_orig data for all capture IDs in the list
review_download_function: review the download function that uses wget and tar to fetch and decompress keypoints data
refactor_download_to_use_requests: refactor the download function to use the requests library instead of os.system wget calls
add_main_guard_to_download_script: add an if __name__ main guard so the download loop runs only when executed directly
